Name: Writ Bookmark
Description: You create an invisible beacon that resembles a floating bookmark to those who can see invisible objects. At any time before the spell ends you can use your reaction to teleport yourself and anything you are carrying back to the space where you left the bookmark, which cannot be moved or touched as long as that space is unoccupied. Spells that remove magical effects may target the bookmark if the caster is aware it is there. You must be within 1 mile and on the same plane as the bookmark to do so, and you become aware if it is no longer possible to move there. Once you use this effect to teleport back to that space, the spell ends.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher the spell’s duration increases to 1 minute at 2nd level, 10 minutes at 3rd, 1 hour at 4th, 10 hours at 5th, 1 day at 6th, 1 month at 7th, 1 year at 8th, and becomes permanent until used at 9th. If cast at 5th level or higher it no longer requires concentration.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
